requirement:
修复路线查询和站点数据传递的 bug。
路线规划服务在查询中转站时数据传递异常，导致路线结果不完整。
需要检查路线服务与基础服务、站点服务之间的数据流。

details.name: ts-route-service
details.rationale: Route planning service likely calls route service for route data, and the bug mentions incomplete route results due to data transfer issues.

details.name: ts-station-service
details.rationale: Station data is involved in the bug, and route planning may query station service for transfer station information.

details.name: ts-basic-service
details.rationale: Basic service may provide foundational data used by route planning, and the requirement mentions checking data flow with basic service.

details.name: ts-travel-plan-service
details.rationale: Travel plan service may also interact with route planning for journey planning, potentially affected by route data issues.

details.name: ts-travel-service
details.rationale: Travel service may consume route planning results, so changes could impact it, though less directly.

details.name: ts-travel2-service
details.rationale: Similar to travel service, may use route planning data for alternative travel options.
